_comment: Houdini RFSoC single-UE client, slot-granular native-TDD demo. BS arms a 30-symbol TDD ring built from frame_schedule (one 4096-tick symbol per slot, '6' beacon strobe on the B slot, rx on every other slot -- a gate close would abandon the continuous capture, see DEMO_VERIFICATION.md). The beacon is a SINGLE 496-sample core per frame at slot_start+384 (strobe offs), played from the TX replay RAM with explicit zeros to the window close. UE: stamp-based hunt -> confirm(x2) -> anchor acquisition with a 30 dB sync-SNR floor (HOUDINI_SYNC_SNR_DB; the metric reads true link dB since the guard-band fix, DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.42), resync = gated drift tracking. Run procedure: CSI_DEMO_WALKTHROUGH.md; evidence ledger: DEMO_VERIFICATION.md. Matched-NCO Zone-1: TX ch1 -> RX ch1, NCO 500 MHz. 30 slots x 4096 = 122880 samps = EXACTLY 1 ms per frame = 320 steps of the 384-tick TX grid. The UE composes one zero-padded burst per frame ([front-pad | P | gap zeros | U] anchored at the floored grid point), so pilot/data placement is sample-exact -- the old per-run snap draws are gone (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.48).
_ue_tdd_pilot_note: UE streams its pilot with the tdd=1 TX stream arg -> the driver TxTickAnchor accepts beacon-referenced starts on the 3.125us/384-tick TDD grid (SH-248/SH-301). ue_tx_advance_ticks is QUANTIZED to the 384-tick anchor grid (values under 192 vanish; leave 0); the 3125 ns anchor grid only constrains the BURST anchor; the burst interior is tick-exact, which the zero-padded composition exploits (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.48).
_bs_hw_framer_note: true selects the BS native-Houdini-TDD framer path. The TDD symbol now EQUALS the sounder slot (4096 ticks; the old 0.5 ms symbol and its multi-copy beacon fill are retired, DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.12/4.16). samps_per_slot must stay <= 4096 (FPGA TX_RAM depth).
_beacon_type_note: Which beacon waveform the BS transmits: legacy | legacy_guard | dot11 | nr. All four are defined in include/beacon_shapes.h and measured on this bench (DEMO_VERIFICATION 8.111-8.116, 4 interleaved rounds, ~8000 detections each). legacy is the default because it has the best detection margin -- worst-case detector ratio 1.21 against a 0.1 bar, versus 1.20 / 0.72 / 0.23 for the others -- and because every prior result in that ledger was taken against it. Timing is indistinguishable across all four (adjacent-difference jitter 0.13-0.17 samples). An unknown name THROWS rather than falling back, so a typo cannot quietly ship a different beacon.
_corr_scale_init_note: Acquisition-only detection threshold; SMALLER is STRICTER (test: corr_scale * peak > trailing local energy). The 2026-08 measured populations (no-beacon 3.4e-07, beacon 0.31..4.2) were taken in the multi-copy-beacon era; acquisition now ALSO requires the 30 dB in-window SNR floor and two grid-consistent confirms, which is what actually rejects the noise-artifact class (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.25/4.32). Re-sync uses corr_scale and relaxes per retry, gated by the same floor.
_tx_advance_note: BENCH CALIBRATION for the wired setup, not a live mechanism. Derived 2026-08-30 from the BS-side pilot_grid_off measurement (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.31/4.35): with the zero-padded burst (sample-exact placement, DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.48) the seat residual is a CONSTANT; 247 = the 205 snap-era value + the measured +42 residual, landing the pilot at its nominal +128 prefix seat. Re-derive after any cabling/latency change: run with HOUDINI_BS_RX_DEBUG=1 across a few restarts and shift tx_advance by the mean pilot_grid_off.
